title: Supporting team brainstorming with a shared AI workspace
summary: A shared workspace that turns spoken brainstorming into evolving ideas. I worked on the 0→1 product design and a digital-first identity, bringing the interface, characters, and motion into one system. Work is ongoing.
coverAlt: A live brainy storm discussion in a laptop: the transcript and listening waveform animate as the focus moves between ideas, with named agents rushing around it.

metadata.label: Context
metadata.value: Zurich Agentic AI Hack · Team project

blocks.title: The brainstorm became the problem
blocks.body: During a hackathon, we kept moving between ideas, raising objections, checking what already existed, and returning to earlier suggestions. Keeping track took attention away from the discussion. We built brainy storm to help a team stay in the conversation and return to the reasoning behind each idea.

blocks.title: Voice-first support that stays in the background
blocks.body: The goal is a fully voice-based experience where the team can keep talking while brainy storm follows the conversation in the background. Agents use that shared context to organize ideas, weigh trade-offs, and bring in research. My design focus was to make that support unobtrusive, with its contributions easy to follow and revisit.

blocks.title: Weighing the trade-offs
blocks.body: Inside each idea page, Prism brings the pros and cons together, helping the team weigh potential value against risks and open questions.

blocks.title: A possible architecture for the idea
blocks.body: Archie sketches how an idea could work as a system, connecting its components in a map the team can discuss and refine.

blocks.title: A wider view of the idea
blocks.body: Scout explores related products and approaches, bringing outside context back to the idea page and surfacing opportunities to investigate.

blocks.title: Designing alongside developers
blocks.body: I worked directly with developers to shape the experience around how the agents work, from capturing a conversation to organizing ideas and adding research within each idea page.

blocks.alt: brainy storm system architecture: live audio becomes a transcript, ideas are classified, and specialist agents generate summaries, pros and cons, architecture, workflows, and competitor research.

blocks.title: An identity designed to move
blocks.body: I approached the brand through its life on screen: how it behaves in the interface, moves, and introduces the product. Distinct characters, shapes, and colors give the agents a recognizable presence. The same graphic language carries through the workspace and motion content.

blocks.title: Give each agent its own character
blocks.body: I built a movement tool to explore how each agent behaves. Choose an agent and adjust its body movement, expression, and tempo. Each keeps its own mix as you move between them.

blocks.title: A graphic language to play with
blocks.body: The same shapes extend into a flexible set of compositions. Explore the recipes, mix their colors, and adjust scale and spacing to see how the visual language holds together.
